tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Highest-emphasis fills: filled buttons, the storage bar indicator, the mini-player play toggle, the focus outline. As text or icons, on `surface` and every `surface-container` step.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `primary` fill.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: The downloaded badge circle and other calm, filled marks. Its own edge does not reach 3:1 on `surface-container-low` in dark, so the glyph on it carries the meaning, never the circle alone.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary-container`, such as the downloaded checkmark.

tokens.name: inverse-primary
tokens.usage: Action text on `inverse-surface`, such as a snackbar's Undo. Dark value is derived, not in DESIGN.md: equals light `surface-tint`.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Low-emphasis accents. As text, on `surface` and every `surface-container` step.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `secondary` fill.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Navigation bar active indicator, selected filter chips, tonal buttons and tonal icon buttons.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `secondary-container`. Light pair is 4.58:1, just above AA, so never lighten it.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Slate-teal accent for secondary information. As text, on `surface` and every `surface-container` step.

tokens.name: on-tertiary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `tertiary` fill.

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Channel emblem placeholder (the initial avatar) when no channel image is cached.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-container
tokens.usage: The initial letter on `tertiary-container`.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: The glyph of a failure message, such as YouTube not loading or a failed download, inside the neutral Banner. Never a block fill. As text or a glyph, on `surface` and every `surface-container` step. Dark value is derived, not in DESIGN.md: Material 3 baseline dark error.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `error` fill. Dark value is derived, not in DESIGN.md: Material 3 baseline dark on-error.

tokens.name: error-container
tokens.usage: Not used. Failure messages use the neutral Banner, not an error-colored block. Dark value is derived, not in DESIGN.md: Material 3 baseline dark error-container.

tokens.name: on-error-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `error-container`. Not used, like `error-container`. Dark value is derived, not in DESIGN.md: Material 3 baseline dark on-error-container.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Level 0: every screen's canvas, the resting top app bar.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons: titles, channel names, numbers. On `surface`, every `surface-container` step and `surface-variant`.

tokens.name: surface-variant
tokens.usage: Same tone as `surface-container-highest`. Prefer the container roles in new work. Dark value is derived, not in DESIGN.md: equals dark `surface-container-highest`, as in light.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text and icons: dates, counts, inactive tabs, standard icon buttons. On `surface` and every `surface-container` step.

tokens.name: surface-dim
tokens.usage: Dimmest surface. Not used by Dewfall's components yet.

tokens.name: surface-bright
tokens.usage: Brightest surface. Not used by Dewfall's components yet.

tokens.name: surface-container-lowest
tokens.usage: Lowest container. Not used by Dewfall's components yet.

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: Level 1: channel groups, the storage meter on Downloads.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Level 2: the top app bar once content scrolls under it, the navigation bar.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Level 2: the mini-player, banners, badges such as CC, focused text fields.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Level 3: dialogs and bottom sheets (with an `outline-variant` hairline). Also thumbnail placeholders and the storage bar track.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Tint for tonal elevation. Matches `primary`'s tone family. Dark value is derived, not in DESIGN.md: equals dark `primary`.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Snackbar background. Dark value is derived, not in DESIGN.md: equals dark `on-surface`.

tokens.name: inverse-on-surface
tokens.usage: Text on `inverse-surface`. Dark value is derived, not in DESIGN.md: equals light `inverse-surface`.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: outlined buttons, outlined icon buttons, unselected chips. 3:1 or better on every surface in both schemes.

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only: the channel emblem ring, dividers, the dialog edge. Too faint to mark a control by itself.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Black in both schemes. The pillars around fullscreen video, and, at `scrim-modal` opacity, the layer behind a bottom sheet or dialog. Never text.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Same as `surface`. Kept so MaterialTheme's background role matches. Dark value is derived, not in DESIGN.md: equals dark `surface`.

tokens.name: on-background
tokens.usage: Same as `on-surface`. Dark value is derived, not in DESIGN.md: equals dark `on-surface`.

tokens.name: primary-fixed
tokens.usage: Fixed role: the same tone in light and dark. Not used by Dewfall's components yet.

tokens.name: primary-fixed-dim
tokens.usage: Fixed role: the same tone in light and dark. Not used by Dewfall's components yet.

tokens.name: on-primary-fixed
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary-fixed` or `primary-fixed-dim`. Same in both schemes.

tokens.name: on-primary-fixed-variant
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary-fixed` or `primary-fixed-dim`. Same in both schemes.

tokens.name: secondary-fixed
tokens.usage: Fixed role: the same tone in light and dark. Not used by Dewfall's components yet.

tokens.name: secondary-fixed-dim
tokens.usage: Fixed role: the same tone in light and dark. Not used by Dewfall's components yet.

tokens.name: on-secondary-fixed
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `secondary-fixed` or `secondary-fixed-dim`. Same in both schemes.

tokens.name: on-secondary-fixed-variant
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `secondary-fixed` or `secondary-fixed-dim`. Same in both schemes.

tokens.name: tertiary-fixed
tokens.usage: Fixed role: the same tone in light and dark. Not used by Dewfall's components yet.

tokens.name: tertiary-fixed-dim
tokens.usage: Fixed role: the same tone in light and dark. Not used by Dewfall's components yet.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-fixed
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `tertiary-fixed` or `tertiary-fixed-dim`. Same in both schemes.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-fixed-variant
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `tertiary-fixed` or `tertiary-fixed-dim`. Same in both schemes.

families.sans: Manrope, "Google Sans Text", Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Used sparingly: onboarding and large landing headers.

styles.name: headline-small
styles.usage: Empty and error state headings, dialog titles.

groups.name: Title
groups.note: Video and channel names. Wrap onto as many lines as needed, never truncate.

styles.name: title-large
styles.usage: The app name in the top app bar, screen titles on detail screens, the video title on the player.

styles.name: title-medium
styles.sample: How reading rooms were lit before electric lamps
styles.usage: Video titles in rows, lists and the mini-player. Wraps, never cut off.

groups.name: Body
groups.note: Descriptions and saved subtitles. Generous line height for reading in low light.

styles.name: body-large
styles.sample: Notice how the porous face of the stone keeps footsteps from echoing down the aisle.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.sample: New videos download tonight while your phone charges.
styles.usage: Supporting text, the screen name under "Dewfall", banners, settings descriptions.

groups.name: Label
groups.note: Numbers and controls: storage readouts, durations, badges, buttons, tab labels.

styles.name: label-large
styles.usage: Button and chip labels, the storage amount.

styles.name: label-medium
styles.usage: Navigation bar labels, the storage meter heading.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: 4dp. Only inside badges and chips (padding, icon-to-label).

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: 8dp. Video row padding, channel group padding, gap between avatar and channel name.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: 16dp. Storage meter padding, gap between thumbnail and title.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: 24dp. Between channel groups.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: 32dp. Around empty-state content.

tokens.name: margin
tokens.usage: 16dp. Screen edge margin on phones.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: 16dp. Gap between columns of the 4-column grid.

radius.note: Material 3 shape scale. DESIGN.md frontmatter names in brackets.

tokens.name: shape-extra-small
tokens.usage: 4dp [sm]. Duration tags and badges (CC, Kept, Watched).

tokens.name: shape-small
tokens.usage: 8dp [DEFAULT]. Video thumbnails, segmented buttons.

tokens.name: shape-medium
tokens.usage: 12dp [md]. Video row press and focus state, chips, the storage meter.

tokens.name: shape-large
tokens.usage: 16dp [lg]. Channel groups, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: shape-extra-large
tokens.usage: 24dp [xl]. Dialogs.

tokens.name: shape-full
tokens.usage: Pill and circle [full]. Buttons, icon buttons, channel emblems, status pills, the navigation indicator, the storage bar.

opacity.note: Material 3 state layers: the content color painted over the component at this opacity.

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: Hover (pointer or stylus).

tokens.name: state-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard and D-pad focus, together with the 2dp `primary` focus outline.

tokens.name: state-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed, under the ripple.

tokens.name: state-dragged
tokens.usage: Dragged.

tokens.name: disabled-content
tokens.usage: Disabled text and icons: `on-surface` at this opacity.

tokens.name: disabled-container
tokens.usage: Disabled button and chip fills: `on-surface` at this opacity.

tokens.name: duration-scrim
tokens.usage: `surface` at this opacity behind the duration tag on a thumbnail, and behind the fullscreen player controls over video.

tokens.name: scrim-modal
tokens.usage: `scrim` at this opacity behind modal bottom sheets and dialogs.
